name: Journey Planner Timeline Foundation
summary: Rebuilds Journey Planner around editable time blocks, duration windows, travel estimates, stable replacements and participant-ready planning contracts.
changes: Replaces fixed morning/afternoon assumptions with real clock-based building blocks
Adds minimum, typical and maximum duration estimates to domain content
Adds opening windows, preferred start times and a domain travel-time matrix
Keeps anchor activities and explicit user replacements stable during recomposition
Replaces only the selected timeline block instead of regenerating unrelated choices
Allows short evening pool blocks after major excursions when time constraints permit
Adds lock controls, transport labels and one-step undo
Adds participant-ready metadata for future all-group, subgroup and individual plans
Extends permanent Journey Planner regression coverage
Synchronizes desktop, mobile and Mission Control identity to v2026.07.24.230
manual_review: Confirm v2026.07.24.230 appears on desktop and mobile
Build a day around Ronda and confirm the anchor remains stable
Replace an evening block and confirm Ronda is retained
Replace a restaurant and confirm only the selected block changes
Check real start/end times and displayed transport estimates
Lock a block and change pace or interest
Use undo and copy the resulting plan
title: Journey Planner Timeline Foundation
test: Kontrollér, at BETA-badget viser v2026.07.24.230 på både computer og mobil.
Vælg Ronda, og kontrollér, at planen viser faktiske start- og sluttider.
Udskift en aktivitet efter Ronda, og kontrollér, at Ronda bliver i planen.
Udskift en restaurant, og kontrollér, at det valgte alternativ erstatter den korrekte byggeklods.
Kontrollér, at andre låste eller valgte aktiviteter ikke ændres unødigt.
Kontrollér, at transporttid vises mellem aktiviteter på forskellige steder.
Lås en aktivitet, skift tempo eller interesse, og kontrollér, at aktiviteten fastholdes.
Tryk på Fortryd ændring, og kontrollér, at den tidligere plan gendannes.
Kontrollér, at en kort aftensvømning kan placeres efter en stor udflugt, når tidsvinduet tillader det.
Kontrollér, at galleri, forespørgselsflow, navigation og Mission Control fortsat virker.
